verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's evidence is entirely about GPU/Kubernetes infrastructure (clusters, node pools, autoscaling, Slurm jobs, Terraform, billing) — there is no mention of a mechanism for AI-native users to configure autonomous background automations, agents, triggers, or scheduled workflows. Autoscaling and Slurm integration are infrastructure-level scaling responses, not user-configurable autonomous automations in the agentic sense.
